source_location: Table 1 (T1/2g, 3.2 mg/kg column; footnote 'termination elimination half-life')
route_quote: The animals were intravenously injected with single bolus of 125I-HLP (3.2, 6.4, or 12.8 mg/kg).
notes: Footnote calls T1/2g 'termination elimination half-life' but it is the fastest phase (1.2-1.5 min < T1/2a 8-10 min < T1/2b 25-30 min; g rate constant 0.53 vs b 0.03); text/discussion treat T1/2b (24.74 min = 0.412 h at 3.2 mg/kg) as the elimination half-life. Dose arm 3.2 mg/kg.

source_location: Table 1 (T1/2g, 6.4 mg/kg column; footnote 'termination elimination half-life')
route_quote: The animals were intravenously injected with single bolus of 125I-HLP (3.2, 6.4, or 12.8 mg/kg).
notes: Same as hl_00090: T1/2g is labelled 'termination' by the footnote but is the fastest phase; elimination half-life at 6.4 mg/kg is T1/2b 27.38 min (0.456 h). Dose arm 6.4 mg/kg.

source_location: Table 1 (T1/2g, 12.8 mg/kg column; footnote 'termination elimination half-life')
route_quote: The animals were intravenously injected with single bolus of 125I-HLP (3.2, 6.4, or 12.8 mg/kg).
notes: Same as hl_00090: T1/2g is the fastest phase despite footnote wording; elimination half-life at 12.8 mg/kg is T1/2b 30.49 min (0.508 h). Dose arm 12.8 mg/kg.
